claim_summary: An arbitrary measurable V-only phase may be inserted into the completed joint-two-hub square-hyperbola receiver without changing its constant. Consequently a literal physical pair with arbitrary symmetric 2x2 core, zero active leaf curvature, and rank-one pair-to-leaf cross A[I,H]=r g^T is controlled by 6 |g^T adj(B)g|^{-1/3}||r||^{-2/3}, hence by 6 Omega_(2,H)^{-1/6}; there is no determinant/minimum-singular-value loss as the second pair eigenvalue crosses zero.

partner_applied.actual_inequality: For B=diag(8,0), eight flat leaves r_i=2/sqrt(8), zero leaf block: ||p_Q||_infinity <= (3/2)2^(1/3)=1.8898815748423097. The new V-phase theorem extends the same bound to B=diag(8,sigma), |sigma|<=1.

scope_warning: The new theorem permits arbitrary functions of the effective hub coordinate V, not arbitrary functions/quadratic curvature of the same leaf variables that form W. Arbitrary same-leaf curvature remains unpaid.
